text:
incident-bot: SEV2 alert: multiple OOMs and container restarts on gpu-pool-3 (paged-attn allocator). potential KV cache fragmentation. auto-created incident.

Mike_oncall: seeing steady memory creep on node gpu-3a, paged allocator metrics show growing resident pages -> OOM at ~98% usage. starting triage.

Lee_runtime: logs show repeated allocation failures in paged_attention::alloc_page(), traces point to KV cache slab refuses to free. suspect fragmentation not eviction.

Anya_sre: are we seeing customer 5xx? metrics dashboard shows a spike in 5xx for hosted inference routes mapped to gpu-pool-3 starting ~10m ago. roughly 12% error rate for top 3 routes.

Mike_oncall: confirmed. route metrics: /v1/generate and /v1/chat had most hits. fallback routing kicked to other pools but capacity saturated.

Lee_runtime: dumping allocator stats to /tmp/alloc-dump.txt and pushing to #eng-runtime. snippet: ```
KV pages: total=262k reserved=258k free_fragments=7.2k
paged-slabs: used=98.7% slab-frag=41% hot-frag=28%
alloc-failures: 47 in last 5m, last_err="cudaErrorIllegalAddress" on attempt to pin page
```

Anya_sre: customer-ops pinged, one paying customer reported latency spikes and 503s. ops says ~4 customers affected intermittently. logged as customer impact.

Mike_oncall: immediate mitigation plan: 1) reduce per-container concurrency to lower peak working set 2) enable aggressive KV eviction policy for affected pools 3) if still flapping, cordon and drain nodes for rolling restart. applying (1) now.

infra-bot: applied override: container.env.REDWOOD_CONCURRENCY=8 on gpu-pool-3 (was 16). rolling config push to 6/8 nodes.

Tess_eng: note: reducing concurrency will push more requests to other pools, may cause cascade. can we enable a soft-fallback to smaller quantized model for best-effort routes?

Lee_runtime: I can enable model fallback for non-enterprise routes in routing policy (fall back to q4_0 variant). doing that now: patching policy.

Mike_oncall: also enabling a temporary KV compaction job on gpu-pool-3: `./tools/kv_compactor --pool gpu-pool-3 --aggressive` — kicking it off, ETA ~60s.

Lee_runtime: compactor logs: "compaction_iteration=1 reclaimed_pages=3200 reclaimed_bytes=24MB" good sign, repeating.

Anya_sre: after compaction and concurrency reduction, memory trend flattened on most nodes. a couple still near 95%. will keep watch. customer error rate halved to ~6% and latency dropping.

Tess_eng: preparing handoff notes for next oncall: fragmentation seems triggered by a regression in paged-attn eviction heuristics rolled last week. create a JIRA linking to runtime PR for rollback.

Mike_oncall: creating incident summary: root cause suspected = paged-attn allocator + KV cache fragmentation + insufficient evict heuristics -> slow memory creep -> OOM. mitigations applied: concurrency cap, KV compaction, model fallback, rolling restarts as last resort.

customer-ops: notified affected customers with incident id INC-613999. ops message: "We applied mitigations and are monitoring; temporary degraded performance while we stabilize."

incident-bot: incident updated: status=stabilized, severity=SEV2 -> monitoring. handoff to Tess_eng at 6139990300.

Tess_eng: acknowledged for handoff. follow-ups: revert problematic heuristic, add stricter slab defrag thresholds, add slow-leak detector alert for paged-slabs > 30% frag over 15m. cc @runtime @sre. :thumbsup:
